How would you like to use the app?
Choose between the free ad-supported version and ad-free Premium. Both options provide the same core app functionality.

This app is an uncalibrated recreational recording aid, not a safety or measuring instrument. Readings can be wrong because of mounting, vibration, sensor limitations, or GPS errors. Never use the app to choose speed, riding line, lean limit, or available grip, and never operate it while riding. Calibrate only with the engine off on level, non-slip ground when the motorcycle is securely supported—ideally with another adult helping. Mandatory legal rights and liability remain unaffected.
Securely mount your smartphone in a holder on the motorcycle.
Would you like a short guided overview of the gauge, ride recording, live data, and ride history?
Watch the gauge start at 0°, lean right and left, then return to center. The measured peaks remain as MAX R and MAX L until you reset them.
Watch the needle and max values
Try the full recording flow: start, wait for GPS, pause a section, resume, then stop and save. On the first real start, the app also requests the required permissions.
The recording is waiting for GPS
Pause recording when you want to exclude a section. The Automation Pack can pause automatically if the phone tips over and resume after GPS detects sustained riding.
The history graph shows recent lean values. During GPS recording, the dashboard also shows speed, distance, and elapsed riding time.
Finished rides show route and statistics. Tap MAX LEAN and V-MAX below to see how the detail view jumps to each important point.
In History you can select, combine, rename, or delete rides. Settings controls recording interval, live-history length, calibration, and lets you restart this tour at any time.

Slowly lean left only as far as you can safely hold it, then return upright. Do not touch the phone. You are responsible for secure footing and your actions.
Slowly lean right only as far as you can safely hold it, then return upright. Do not touch the phone. You are responsible for secure footing and your actions.

How location, ride, advertising, map, and purchase data are handled.
Rules for safe use, purchases, availability, and liability.
Accuracy limits and essential motorcycle safety rules.
License texts and notices for included software components.
Origin and rights information for app graphics and map material.

With your permission, the app reads precise location, speed, motion sensors, timestamps, and device orientation to calculate lean values and record rides. Ride names, routes, statistics, calibration, and settings are stored locally on your device. App backup and device-transfer backup are disabled for this data. The data remains until you delete a ride, clear app data, or uninstall the app.

The free version uses Google Mobile Ads. Choosing free ad-supported access is a product choice, not consent to personalized advertising or optional tracking. Before any ad request, Google’s User Messaging Platform refreshes the applicable privacy status and displays a separate privacy message where required. Depending on your choice and Google’s configuration, Google may process device or advertising identifiers, IP address, app interactions, diagnostics, and approximate location for delivery, fraud prevention, measurement, or personalization. Where supported, non-personalized or limited ads may appear after a refusal. If no lawful ad delivery is available, only the ad-free Premium option remains; legal information, purchase restoration, and management of existing ride data stay accessible. You can reopen your advertising privacy choices at any time. The legal basis for storage or access requiring consent is your consent; otherwise Google and the provider rely on the legal bases stated in their respective notices.

When a route map is displayed, map tiles are requested directly from the OpenStreetMap Foundation tile service. The service receives technical connection data such as your IP address, user agent, request time, and the requested tile coordinates, which reveal the displayed geographic area. The request is necessary to provide the map you opened. OpenStreetMap data is licensed under the ODbL; attribution is displayed on every map.

One-time purchases and subscriptions are processed by Google Play. Google processes the Google account, product, purchase-token, payment, and transaction data needed for the purchase. The app receives product availability, localized price, purchase state, and entitlement information, but not your full payment-card details.

GPX files are read only after you select them. Exported GPX files can contain precise routes and timestamps. They leave the app only when you explicitly open or share them with another app. The receiving app then processes the file under its own privacy terms.

Locally stored rides remain until you delete them. Data processed by Google or OpenStreetMap is retained under those providers’ policies and may be processed outside your country with the safeguards described by them. No developer-operated user account or ride-data server is used by this app.

Where the GDPR applies, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing, and may withdraw consent for the future. You may also complain to a competent data-protection authority. Use the contact above. Locally stored rides can be deleted directly in Ride History.

The app is intended for adult motorcycle riders and is not designed or directed to children. Do not use the app or advertising features for a child-directed service without a separate legal and technical review.

These terms apply to use of Lean Angle Tracker. The app estimates lean angle from phone sensors, records GPS rides, displays maps and statistics, and may offer optional purchases. It is a recreational data-recording tool and does not provide navigation, rider training, vehicle control, emergency assistance, or safety certification.

Core functionality is offered either free with lawful advertising or ad-free through the Premium subscription. Choosing the free product mode does not replace privacy consent. Consent for optional advertising data processing is requested separately and can be withdrawn. If no advertising can lawfully be delivered under the current privacy choice, free core access is unavailable. Privacy and legal information, purchase restoration, and access to existing ride data for export or deletion remain available. The Premium price, billing period, and included features are shown before purchase.

Displayed values are estimates. Accuracy depends on the phone, mounting, calibration, vibration, temperature, sensor drift, software state, and GPS reception. Values may be delayed, incomplete, or wrong and must not be used to determine speed, riding line, traction, safe lean, braking points, or legal compliance.

Do not touch, read, configure, or otherwise operate the phone while riding. Follow traffic law, vehicle instructions, mounting-system limits, and the directions of public authorities. Stop using the app if it distracts you, the mount is loose, or readings appear implausible. Calibration must be performed stationary with the engine off, on level non-slip ground, with secure support and preferably another adult helping.

You remain responsible for ride names, imported files, exports, and sharing. GPX exports can reveal sensitive home, work, and travel locations. Review the route and recipient before sharing. Keep your own backup of any data you need; app data can be lost through deletion, device failure, or uninstalling.

Purchases are offered and billed through Google Play at the price and billing period shown in the Google Play purchase dialog. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled in Google Play. Entitlements require a valid purchase state and may take time to synchronize. Mandatory consumer rights, including applicable withdrawal or remedy rights, are not limited by these terms.

Continuous availability, uninterrupted GPS reception, map delivery, advertising, or compatibility with every device is not promised. Features may be corrected, secured, or adapted through updates. Security and compatibility updates should be installed promptly.

The statutory rules for digital products and purchases apply. Nothing in these terms excludes remedies that cannot legally be excluded. Public descriptions are intended to describe the current feature set, not to guarantee professional measurement accuracy or suitability for a particular riding purpose.

Liability is not excluded for intent or gross negligence, for injury to life, body, or health, under mandatory product-liability law, or where liability cannot otherwise legally be limited. For ordinary negligence, liability is limited only to the extent permitted by applicable law. These terms do not shift responsibility for a defective app to the user.

The law at the provider’s establishment applies only insofar as this does not deprive consumers of mandatory protection available in their country of habitual residence. Mandatory local law and competent consumer forums remain unaffected.

Before release, add any trade-register, representative, supervisory-authority, professional-law, and VAT identification information that applies to the actual provider. If none applies, no such number should be invented.

Lean Angle Tracker is neither calibrated measuring equipment nor a component of the motorcycle. It cannot determine available grip, safe speed, collision risk, road condition, tire condition, or rider skill. Sensor and GPS values can fail without warning.

Set up the app before moving and review results only after stopping safely. Never chase a displayed maximum or change your riding to improve an app statistic. A passenger should also avoid distracting the rider.

Calibrate only while stationary, with the engine off, on firm level non-slip ground, away from traffic. Secure the motorcycle against falling and use a suitable stand or another capable adult where appropriate. Stop immediately if the motorcycle cannot be held safely. Do not exceed your normal controlled range.

Use a mount approved for the phone, motorcycle, expected vibration, weather, and speed. Check that it does not obstruct controls, instruments, steering, or view. Inspect the mount before every ride and follow phone and vehicle manufacturers’ instructions.

Traffic, phone-use, recording, and mounting laws vary by country. Use the app only where lawful. If an incident occurs, prioritize emergency services and safety; the app is not an emergency recorder and may not contain complete or reliable evidence.

The motorcycle and launcher artwork in this app was created through multiple Google Gemini generation iterations and selected and adapted for this project. Generation prompts, intermediate versions, and final asset history should be retained in the project’s provenance records. No third-party logo or stock-art license is claimed for these assets.

Rights in fully AI-generated material can differ by jurisdiction and may be limited. Human selection and editing do not guarantee exclusive rights. Report a substantiated rights concern to the provider contact shown in the Legal notice so the material can be reviewed promptly.

Map data and tiles are provided by OpenStreetMap contributors and are subject to the Open Database License and OpenStreetMap tile-service policies. “© OpenStreetMap contributors” is displayed on each map and links to the license information.

This app includes AndroidX and Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Gson, Room, and osmdroid under the Apache License 2.0, plus other direct and transitive components under their respective licenses. The app’s own name, artwork, and product content are not placed under those open-source licenses.

The complete build-specific notice list is generated from the resolved dependency graph. It includes full licence text and Google SDK third-party notices for the exact app version. Review the generated list after every dependency update.
OpenStreetMap map data is available under the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). The attribution displayed on each map links to the current copyright and licence information.
